primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
